items.text: Baltimore QB: Lamar Jackson on IR (thumb), likely out for the regular season; Tyler Huntley (turf toe) out for the season. Jacoby Brissett, who started Week 10, is expected to start. The schedule still lists Huntley.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Baltimore: DL Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring) and rookie G Olaivavega Ioane (shoulder) left Monday's loss to LAC. OUT - S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee). IR - C Ethan Pocic, K Tyler Loop, RB Adam Randall.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Carolina: OUT last week - LB Bobby Okereke, CB Will Lee III, OT Ikem Ekwonu (knee). IR - CB Jaycee Horn, G Brady Christensen, CB Mike Jackson, RB Jonathon Brooks. Bryce Young starts.
